value.rationale: The motivating 2026 publication studies exactly the reduced-progression mean and leaves every nontrivial secondary term inside O(x^(1/2+eps)). The theorem separates an explicitly nonzero square-root quadratic-character bias between residue classes 1 and 2 mod 3 with O(x^(1/3+eps)) remainder; the coefficient is a natural analytic arithmetic invariant, and its strict sign is a new quantified phenomenon relative to the inspected leading-only literature.
